children: China's extended Golden Week holiday isn't likely to provide a major boost to consumption recovery, Deutsche Bank analyst Sammi Xu says in a note. It says domestic travel was subdued, with limited spending. Government estimates show that during the Oct. 1-4 period, cross-regional passenger trips were broadly flat year over year, with railway volumes up 8.4% and highway and air traffic falling 0.6% and 2.3%, respectively. Hotel room rates in major cities were weaker than expected, suggesting a modestly negative read-through for 4Q hotel revenue per available room. By contrast, outbound travel was robust, with mainland visitors to Hong Kong and Macau rising 9.26% and 10.9%, respectively. (venkat.pr@wsj.com)
